Rebeltrack Example

Source: vignettes/rebeltrack_example.Rmd
rebeltrack_example.Rmd

Load packages 

library(tidyverse)
library(rebeltrack)

Load Dataset 

dataset <- rebeltrack_load_dataset(type = UCDP_STATE_BASED, region = "Africa")
## /private/var/folders/qw/xk69j6f10yldjd4c8gdl78rw0000gp/T/RtmpaWgVUR/temp_libpath17a5165ab142f/rebeltrack/extdata/config.yml

Create RebelTrack DataFrame 

data <- rebeltrack_dataframe(dataset,
                             side = SIDE_B,
                             period = "month",
                             balanced = TRUE)
data

Generate Variables

Using %>% Pipes 

data <- data %>% 
  rebeltrack_event_count(event_count) %>% 
  rebeltrack_days_affected(days_affected) %>% 
  rebeltrack_casualty_count(SIDE_A, casualties_A) %>% 
  rebeltrack_casualty_count(SIDE_B, casualties_B)
  
data

Without %>% Pipes 

data <- rebeltrack_dataframe(dataset,
                             side = SIDE_B,
                             period = "month",
                             balanced = TRUE)

data <- rebeltrack_event_count(data, event_count) 
data <- rebeltrack_days_affected(data, days_affected)
data <- rebeltrack_casualty_count(data, SIDE_A, casualties_A) 
data <- rebeltrack_casualty_count(data, SIDE_B, casualties_B)
